name: openlocalcrm
description: Pins the module type at the repository root so playwright.config.ts is loaded as CommonJS regardless of where the repo is checked out. Without it, an ancestor package.json declaring "type": "module" (e.g. a tooling repo the CRM is nested in) makes Node load the config as ESM, where __dirname is undefined and bare imports resolve differently — see scripts/run-e2e.sh.
